issues.message: 'Sarvottam Cables makes cables, and copper is its main raw material [E05].': E05 supports copper as main raw material, but not that the company makes cables.
'Management guides to FY27 revenue growth of 15 to 17 percent, which is guidance, not a result [E08].': Guidance of 15 to 17 percent is quoted, but the quote does not name FY27.

'**GST demand:** A tax demand of ₹46.3 crore, covering earlier years, was disclosed on 2 September 20': E40 supports the ₹46.3 crore amount and earlier years, but not the 2 September 2026 disclosure date.

"The filing is better supported, because it is the company's own document and its year-ago base gives": C1 supports the 18.0% from 1248 vs 1058, but not the claim that the filing is the company's own document.
'**Pledge conflict:** A 2024 article cited 35% pledged [E35].': E35 supports the 35% pledged figure, but the quote does not show the 2024 date.
